description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of response types across “Standard” and “Context” conditions. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Standard” and “Context”, listed vertically. The vertical axis represents percentage, labeled as such, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. Each category has a stacked bar composed of three segments representing “Context”, “Generated Response”, and “Other”, as indicated by the legend and corresponding colors: blue, orange, and green, respectively. For the “Standard” condition, the “Context” segment is approximately 23.6%, the “Generated Response” segment is approximately 51.1%, and the “Other” segment is approximately 25.3%. In the “Context” condition, the “Context” segment is approximately 60.6%, the “Generated Response” segment is approximately 31.7%, and the “Other” segment is approximately 7.7%. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
